raw_excerpt: Mavis skill: landing-page-builder. Creates Awwwards-level landing pages with cinematic hero sections, deployed online. Spec-first workflow: Step 1 Gather Requirements, Step 2 Refine UI Requirement & Generate spec.md, Step 3-4 design system + generate HTML/CSS/JS, Step 5 deploy. spec.md must include: expanded prompt (Project Context, Hero Section, Typography, Layout, Motion), Tech Strategy (Stack HTML5 + modern CSS + minimal JS, Asset Protocol), Design System (Color Palette, Typography, Layout). Strict color constraint. Hero Section is Video-First.
